content.name: Innate Sorcery
entries: An event in your past left an indelible mark on you, infusing you with simmering magic. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}, you can unleash that magic for 1 minute, during which you gain the following benefits:

items: The spell save DC of your Sorcerer spells increases by 1.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on the attack rolls of Sorcerer spells you cast.

entries: You can use this feature twice, and you regain all expended uses of it when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}.
